outcome: Four complete evidence-backed records and four partial-evidence records remain; no scalable source route verified. The assigned request budget was exceeded by eight and disclosed.
shortfallReason: Only four records have full ingredient-and-method completeness established by the saved source evidence. Four other stored candidates have useful captured facts but their saved grouped summaries do not establish full method coverage; they are marked partial. Five further candidates were rejected for inadequate evidence. No terms-verified bulk route or source capable of supplying the remaining 996 records was established. Actual underlying targets were 44 against an authorized 36; no further requests were made.
